m: वैधारय m. a patr. ĀrṣBr.
वैधातकि (?) m. = next, L.

m: वैधात्री f. a species of plant (= ब्राह्मी), L.

v: pu॰ viDAturapatyam aR । sanatkumArAdO 1 muniBede amaraH । 2 vrAhyAM (vAmanahAwi) strI rAjani॰ ।
m: वैधात्र mf(ई)n. (fr. वि-धातृ) derived from Brahmā or fate, Rājat.
वैधात्र m. patr. of Sanatkumāra, L.

k.v: सनत्कुमारो वैधात्रः स्वर्वैद्यावश्विनीसुतौ। नासत्यावश्विनौ दस्रावाश्विनेयौ च तावुभौ॥

m: वैधूमाग्नी f. N. of a city in the country of the Śālvas, L.

s: tri, (viDinA boDitaH । viDi + aR .) viDiboDitaH । yaTA । adfzwArTEkajAtIyakarmmaRaH kAladeSakartrAdInAM prayogAnubanDavEDahetuBUtAnAmaBede uddiSyaviSezAgrahaH । iti prAyaScittatattvam ॥ * ॥ aTa vEDahiMsAvicAraH । “mA hiMsyAt sarvvA BUtAni ityatra sarvvaSabdasya vyApakArTaparatayA etadviDimanullaNGya vAyavyaM SvetamAlaBeta । ityAdiviDervizayAprApteragatyA vEDAtiriktavizayatvam । sarvvAH sarvvARi Candasi vA ityanena tat padaM sidDam । yadapi nAnAdarSanawIkAkfdBirvvAcaspatimiSrEstattvakOmudyAmaBihitam । ‘na ca mA hiMsyAt sarvvA BUtAni iti sAmAnyaSAstraM viSezaSAstreRa agnIsomIyaM paSumAlaBeta ityanena vADyeta iti vAcyaM viroDABAvAt । viroDe hi balIyasA durbbalaM vADyate । na cAsti viroDaH BinnavizayatvAt । taTA hi । mA hiMsyAditi nizeDena hiMsAyA anarTahetuBAvo jYApyate na punarakratvarTatvamapi । na cAnarTahetutvakratUpakArakatvayoH kaScidasti viroDaH । hiMsA hi puruzasya dozamAvakzyati kratoSca upakarizyati’ ityantena । tadapi sAMKyanaye । mImAMsakamate tu viroDa eva । taTA hi । gurunaye na Kalu sarvvaBUtahiMsABAvavizayakaM kAryyamiti nizeDaviDyarTasya vADaM vinA agnIsomIyapaSvAlamBanavizayakaM kAryyamiti BAvaviDyarTa upapadyate । Bawwanaye tu aNge yaTA taTAstu । na ca muKyapaSuyAge puruzArTe paSuhiMsanasyArTasADanatvamanarTa-sADanatvaYcopapadyate viroDAt । vastutastu aNge'pi viroDo'styeva kutaH viDereza svaBAvo yaH svavizayasya sAkzAt paramparayA vA puruzArTasADanatvamavagamayati । anyaTA aNgAnAM praDAnopakArakatvamapi nANgIkriyate । arTasADanatvaM balavadanizwAnanubanDIzwasADanatvaM anarTasADanatvaM balavadanizwasADanatvaM na cAnayorekatra samAveSa iti । ataevoktaM tasmAdyajYe vaDo'vaDaH iti । nanvevaM SyenenABicaran yajeta ityatra Syenasya SatruvaDarUpezwasADanatvamavagatam । aBicAro mUlakarmma ca iti manunA upapAtakagaRamaDye pAWAdanizwasADanatvamavagatam । tadetat kaTamupapadyatAmiti cenmEvam । AtatAyinamAyAntaM hanyAdevAvicArayan ityekavAkyatayA AtatAyisTale izwasADanatvaM anAtatAyisTale tUpapAtakatvena balavadanizwasADanatvamityaviroDa iti । gurucaraRA apyevam .” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
m: वैध mf(ई)n. (fr. विधि) enjoined by rule or precept, prescribed, legal (-त्व n.), TS., Sch.; KātyŚr., Sch. &c.
a: वैध — a. (धी f.), वैधिक a. (की f.) [विधित आगतः अण् ठक् वा] 1 Conformable to rule, settled, fixed, ritual. --2 Legal, lawful.

v: strI karma॰ । vedavihitahiMsAyAm “yA vedavihitA hiMsA niyatA'smiMScarAcare । ahiMsAmeva tAM vidyAt vedAt Darmo hi nirbaBO” manuH । atra niyatetyupAdAnAt nitye paSvizwyAdO hiMsAyA ahiMsAtvaM na tu kAmye'pIti sampradAyavidaH । pizwapaSumImAMsAyAYca taTEvoktaM “kuryyAt GftapaSuM saNge kuryyAt pizwapaSuM taTA” manunA saNge kAmanAyAM pizwapaSUnAmeva viDAnAt । viSezataH kalO “mAMsadAnaM taTA SrAdDe” “aSvAlamBaM gavAlamBam” iti ca kalivarjyezUkteH kAmyabalidAnAdi nizeDaH । hisAyA anarTasADanatve'pi vEDahiMsAyA arTasADanatvam vEdyakoktasaMskAraBedena vizasyeveti boDyam । ti॰ ta॰ mataBedena ca vEDahiMsA uBayarUpatvaM nirUpitaM yaTA “mA hiMsyAt sarvABUtAni” ityatra sarvaSabdasya vyApakArTaparatayA etadviDimanulaNGya “vAyavyaM SvetamAlaBet” ityAdiviDervizayAprApteragatyA vEDAtiriktavizayatvaM sarvA sarvARi Candasi vetyanena tatpada sidDam । yadapi nAnAdarSanawIkAkfdBirvAcaspatimiSrEstattvakOmudyAmaBihitaM “na ca mA hiMsyAt sarvA BUtAni” iti sAmAnyaSAstraM viSezaSAstreRa “agnIzomIyaM paSumAlaBeta” ityanena bADyate iti vAcyaM viroDABAvAt viroDe hi balIyasA durbalaM bADyate । na cAsti viroDaH BinnavizayatvAt । taTA hi mA hiMsyAditi nizeDena hiMsAyA anarTahetuBAvo jYApyate na punarakratvarTatvamapi । agnIzomIyaM paSumAlaBetetyanena tu paSuhiMsAyAH kratvarTatvamucyate na tvanarTahetuBAvastaTA sati vAkyaBedaprasaNgAt । na cAnarTahetutvakratUpakArakatvayoH kaScidasti viroDaH । hiMsA hi puruzasya dozamAvakzyati kratoScopakarizyatItyantena, tadapi sAMKyanaye । mImAMsakamate tu viroDa eva taTA hi gurunaye na Kalu sarvaBUtahiMsABAvavizayakaM kAryyam iti nizeDaviDyarTasya bADaM vinA agnIzomIyapaSvAlammanavizayakaM kAryyamiti BAvaviDyarTa upapadyate । Bawwanaye tu aNge yaTA taTAstu । na ca muKyapaSuyAge puruzArTapaSuhiMsanasyArTasADanatvamanarTasADanatvaYcopapadyate viroDAt । vastutastu aNge'pi viroDo'styeva kuto? viDereza svaBAvo yat svavizayasya sAkzAt paramparayA vA puruzArTasADanatvamavagamayati anyaTA'NgAnAM praDAnopakArakatvamapi nANgokriyeta । arTasADanatvaM balavadanizwAmanUbanDIzwasADanatvam anarTasADanatvaM balavadanizwasADanatvaM na cAnayorekatra samAveSa iti । ataevoktaM “tasmAdyajYe baDo'baDaH” iti । nanvevaM “SyenenABicaran yajeta” ityatra Syenasya SatrubaDarUpezwasADa vamavagatama “aBicAro mUlakarma ca” iti manUnA upapAtakagaRamaDya pAWAdanizwasAvanatvamavagatam । tadetat kaTamupapadyatAmiti cenmEvaM “AtatAyinamAyAntaM hanyAdevAvicArayan” ityeka॰ vAkyatayA AtatAyisTale izwasADanatvam anAtatAyisTale tUpapAtakatvena balavadanizwasADanatvamityaviroDa iti gurucaraRAH” ।

m: वैध—हिंसाघ-तिमिर-मार्तण्डोदय m. N. of wk. (containing an apology for animal sacrifices as enjoined in the Śruti and Smṛti, and composed A.D. 1854).
वैधर्मिक mfn. (fr. वि-धर्म) unlawful, MBh. (v.l. विधर्मक, or ˚मिक).

v: na॰ virudDo Darmo yasya tasya BAvaH zyaY । 1 virudDaDa । rmatve 2 anyalakzaRe ca ।
m: वैधर्म्य n. unlawfulness, injustice, MBh.; R.
difference of duty or obligation, W.
difference, heterogeneity, Suśr.; Kaṇ. &c.
a: वैधर्म्यं — 1 Dissimilarity, difference. --2 Difference of characteristic qualities. --3 Difference of duty or obligation. --4 Contrariety. --5 Unlawfulness, impropriety, injustice. --6 Heterodoxy.

m: वैधर्म्य—सम m. (in log.) a fallacy based on dissimilarity, Nyāyad.
वैधस mf(ई)n. (fr. वेधस्) derived from fate, Naiṣ.
composed by Brahmā, Cat.
वैधस m. patr. of Hari-ścandra, AitBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
वैध—त्व n.
वैधव m. (fr. 1. विधु) ‘son of the Moon’, N. of Budha, Vikr.
वैधवेय m. (fr. विधवा) the son of a widow, Śak.
a: वैधवेयः — The son of a widow.

v: na॰ viDavAyA BAvaH zyaY । pativirahe “navavEDavyamasahyavedanam” iti kumAraH ।
m: वैधव्य n. widowhood, MBh.; Hariv.; Kāv. &c.
वैधव्य—लक्षणोपेता f. a girl who has the marks of widowhood (unfit for marriage), L.
वैधव्य—निर्णय m. N. of wk.
वैधव्य—वेणी f. a widow's braid, Hcar.

s: tri, (viDiM padDatimevAnusftya vyavaharati । viDi + Qak । yadvA, viDeye karttavye anaBijYaH । viDeya + aR । yadbA, virudDaM Deyamasya । tataH svArTe aR । padDatimASritya kriyAkAritvAt yuktAyuktavivekaSUnyatvAcca taTAtvamasya .) mUrKaH । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 48 ॥ (yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm । 6 । 159 । “puMScalI jAlmavEDeyabAlakAdrogDfniBarA । samaBUdapraveSArhA rAjaparzanmanasvinAm ॥”) viDisambanDI viDeyasambanDI ca ॥
v: tri॰ viDIyate'sO vi + DA--yat tataH svArTe aR । mUrKe amaraH ।
m: वैधेय mfn. (fr. विधि) ‘afflicted by fate’, stupid, foolish
वैधेय m. an idiot, fool, Kāv.; Rājat.
वैधेय mfn. relating to rule or precept, prescribed, MW.
वैधेय m. N. of a disciple of Yājñavalkya (the celebrated teacher of the White Yajur-veda), Pur.
वैधेय m. pl. N. of a school of the White Yajur-veda, Caraṇ.; Āryav.
a: वैधेय — a. (यी f.) 1 According to rule, prescribed. --2 Foolish, silly, stupid. --यः A fool, an idiot: प्रलपत्येष वैधेयः Ś. 2; सर्वत्र प्रमादी वैधयः V. 2.

m: वैधेय-ता f. = विधेय-ता, dependence on, the being in the power of (ifc.), Daś.
वैधृता f. N. of the wife of Āryaka (mother of Dharma-setu), ib.

वैधृत m. (fr. वि-धृति) N. of a partic. Yoga (or conjunction of the sun and moon when they are on the same side of either solstitial point [i.e. in the same Ayana, whether Uttarāyaṇa or Dakṣiṇāyana] and of equal declination, and when the sum of their longitude amounts to 360 degrees; this is considered a malignant aspect, cf. व्य्-अतिपात), Var.
N. of Indra in the 11th Manv-antara, BhP.
वैधृत n. (with वासिष्ठ) N. of a Sāman, L.
a: वैधृतं, वैधृति — f. N. of a particular position of the sun and moon (योग), considered as very inauspicious and malignant.

m: वैधृत—वासिष्ठ n. N. of a Sāman, ib.

s: puM, vizkamBAdisaptaviMSatiyogAntargataSezayogaH । tasya tyAjyatvaM yaTA, -- “pariGasya tyajedardDaM sapta SUle ca nAqikAH । gaRqavyAGAtayoH zaw ca nava harzaRavajrayoH । vEDftivyatipAtO ca samastO parivarjjayet ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥ * ॥ tatra jAtaPalaM yaTA, kozWIpradIpe । “mEtrIvihInaH kuwilaH KalaSca mUrKo daridraH paravaYcakaSca । kukarmmakarttA paradAraBarttA BavennaroM vEDftilabDajanmA ॥” amftayoge tasya varjyatvamavarjyatvaYca yaTA, -- “yadi vfzwivyatIpAtO dinaM vApyaSuBaM Bavet । hanyate'mftayogena BAskareRa tamo yaTA ॥ hantyamftAKyo yogaH sarvvARyaSuBAni helayA niyatam । na Bavati punariha Sakto vEDftivfzwivyatIpAte ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥ (devatAviSezaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 8 । 1 । 29 । “devA vEDftayo nAma viDftestanayA nfpa । nazwAH kAlena yErvedA viDftAH svena tejasA ॥”)
v: pu॰ vigatA DftiryasmAt pfzo॰ vfdDiH । vizkamBAdizu maDye 1 antime yoge । sUryyacandrayoH krAntisAsyenAnIte aSuBasUcake 2 vahniBede tatra vEDftaSabdo'pi yaToktaM sU॰ si॰ “ekAyanagatO syAtAM sUryyAvandramasO yadA । tadyute maRqale krAntyostulyatve vEDftABiDaH” । pAtaSabde 4389 pf॰ vistarA dfSyaH । upayamaSabde 1265 pf॰ dfSyam ।
m: वैधृति f. the above position of the sun and moon, Saṃskārak.; Hcat.
the Yoga star of the 27th lunar mansion, MW.
वैधृति m. N. of Indra in the 11th Manv-antara (= वैधृत), BhP.
वैधृति m. pl. N. of a class of gods, ib.
वैधृति—शान्ति f. N. of wk.
वैधृति—जनन-शान्ति f. N. of wk.
वैधृति—व्यतीपात-संक्रान्ति-जनन-शान्ति f. N. of wk.
वैधृत्य the above position of the sun and moon, Kauś.
वैधिक mf(ई)n. in accordance with rule, preceptive, ritual, W.
वैधुरी f. (fr. वि-धुर) adversity, adverseness (विधि-वैध्˚, adv˚ of fate), Prasannar.
वैधुर्य n. desolation, Kathās.
bereavement, deprivation, absence (˚यं वि-√ धा, ‘to deprive of’, ‘remove’), Bālar.; Sāh.
misery, wretchedness, desperate plight, Kathās.; Rājat.
agitation, tremulousness, MW.
वैध्यत m. N. of Yama's doorkeeper, L.
